component.name: Akshara
component.summary: Focused PDF reader with neural text-to-speech

description.p: Akshara is a calm, distraction-free PDF reader built for deep reading. It reads books aloud with natural neural voices, highlights each sentence as it is spoken, and helps you build a reading habit with a built-in Pomodoro timer and private, local reading analytics.

ul.li: Neural text-to-speech (Kokoro-82M) with sentence highlighting and continuous reading
Dark, light and sepia themes that recolour pages but keep images intact
Highlights, notes and bookmarks, exportable as Markdown
Table of contents, fast whole-document search and clickable links
Reading analytics: streaks, time per book, pages read and words heard

description.p: A full modernisation: new viewer with HiDPI rendering, themes, highlights and notes, search, table of contents, rewritten speech engine and packaging.
